claims.text: The Presidency describes Cape Town’s Government House after 1806 occupation. The Deeds Journal distinguishes Pretoria’s founding, capital designation and actual government transfer. NAM then describes annexation and later foreign-relations limitations. A later city seat is not timeless government or consent; settler and imperial accounts cannot speak for all African residents.
